Name: Simple Whiskey
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
Create Peated Malt by putting Wheat and Coal into a Charcoal Kiln. Takes 7 days.

Create Single Malt Whiskey by putting Peated Malt into a Keg. Takes 11 days.

Overall the production takes about 50% longer than Ancient Fruit Wine, and therefore requires more Kegs for the same amount of crop, but sells for about 50% more.

Prior to completion of the Community Center, the sell price is halved compared to this, for more balance with other year 1 crops. This also works on the Joja route.

Turns Wheat into a cash crop for those that like to grow it, or those that prefer Whiskey to Wine overall.
